Title: TWD - Eccentric Billings, Charlotte, NC USA

Messages.Author: yafka
Messages.Body:
Eccentric Billings: Charlotte, NC
Luck Factory Games, Concord (NC), USA
September 2nd, 2023
2R+F
10 players
Vadim Matveev
www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10907

We had a great tournament this day, as we said goodbye Benjamin Billings, who is moving to the other side of the country next month. Benjamin, we will miss you.

Ten players were in attendance. After two rounds the preliminary standings were:

Vadim Matveev - 2 GW 8 VP
Bejamin Billings - 1 GW 5.5 VP
Kate Schofield - 1.5 VP
Benjamin Burton - 1 VP
Brett Schofield - 1 VP
John Byrd - 0.5 VP
Jason Joy - 0
Jose LaFunete - 0
Jordan Beall - 0
Jaye Barnes - 0

In the final round the seating order was:

Bejamin Burton - Anarch Gangrel Bruise and Bleed
Kate Schofield - Libertine Ball Pre-Con Deck
Brett Schofield - Toreador Block, Bleed, Shoot
Vadim Metveev - Thucimia Stealth Bleed
Benjamin Billings - Giovanni Shambling Hordes

In the finals, it was a clean sweep for Vadim, who received all 5 VPs in the final round.

Congratulations to Vadim on his amazing win!
